_use_when: A real screenshot is the proof and needs one obvious callout. Fill {PLACEHOLDERS} from the person's material before generating.

output.mobile_read: The red arrow and the short label must read at phone feed size.

reference_images.use: The supplied screenshot is the whole image.
reference_images.preserve: Every real UI element, number, layout detail and visible state.
reference_images.allowed_changes: Tighter crop, blur of private details, one red arrow, one short yellow label.

main_visual.description: The person's real report screenshot with one row singled out: {ROW THE PERSON WANTS HIGHLIGHTED}.
main_visual.state_or_action: A hand drawn style arrow points at that row.

composition.framing: tight crop around the relevant row
composition.layout: red arrow comes in from lower left; label sits beside the arrow without covering data
composition.annotation_plan: One red arrow and one label reading "this one".
composition.scroll_stop: A rough red arrow on a real screen

text_elements.color: yellow on dark or red on light, whichever contrasts
text_elements.rules: Include only this text, exactly once.

constraints: Do not recreate or redraw the screenshot.
No new rows, numbers, logos or UI states.
Blur any customer names, emails or order numbers.
